title: Targeted Nursing Interventions for Improving Stroke Care and Outcomes in the Rural Setting: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association
shortTitle: Targeted Nursing Interventions for Improving Stroke Care and Outcomes in the R

recommendations.classNote: Scope summary quoted from the publication abstract; the full graded recommendations are in the linked source.
recommendations.text: Stroke remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality in the United States, with rural-dwelling populations facing significant disparities in stroke prevalence, access to care, and outcomes. Rural-dwelling communities are particularly burdened by limited infrastructure and a higher prevalence of uncontrolled risk factors such as hypertension, diabetes, and obesity. Geographic isolation and long distances to medical facilities hinder timely access to acute stroke care.
